in_marathi.name: Namratha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight, Pleased, Graceful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Namratha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘namas’, meaning bow or adoration, and ‘ratha’ meaning chariot. The name Namratha symbolizes a person who is pleased and delights in the divine. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of various goddesses.
